title: Frequently Asked Questions
use_cases: Use when inviting external editors to review manuscript passages
Configure when managing team-based permissions and collaboration
Implement when setting up periodic project backups or data portability
Use when wanting to trigger AI analysis without relying on automated background processes
content:
#### Can I work with an editor inside Storywell?

Yes. Authors can invite editors by email, control permissions, and review inline comment threads on manuscript passages.

#### Does AI run on every autosave?

No. Autosave protects your writing continuously, while AI extraction is triggered on manual saves to control costs and keep results intentional.

#### Can I export my project data?

Yes. You can export the manuscript and your world encyclopedia for external review, sharing, and long-term backups.
